name: Top-down RPG skeleton (Godot)
description: Forces the checkEngineFit matrix on a brief that's a clear Godot win: top-down RPG with NPC dialog, save system, autoload state. Catches engine misroutes (e.g. agent picking three for tilemap-heavy 2D).
brief: Create a top-down 2D RPG skeleton with player movement, an NPC that can be spoken to via dialog box, and a save/load slot. Use Godot 4.3.
